strengths: Snapshot guards explicitly stop on verification failure, including inside Bash conditions.
Fallback requires verified, nonce-bound backend evidence matching the exit status and producer.
Producer mismatches receive explicit diagnostics, and backend stderr remains visible.
summary: Reviewed all 370 committed membership paths for failure propagation, diagnostics and fallback behavior. No reportable error-handling defects found; runtime suites were not run under the read-only constraint.
